slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: “都赶紧给我滚起来，若是敢误了贵人们的事情，仔细你们的皮子！”
尖锐刺耳的公鸭嗓声音传入耳中，躺在冰冷硌人木板床上的少年睁开眼睛，随即手脚麻利的开始穿着衣衫。
经过几天的适应，他已经清楚的知道动作迟缓的后果，轻则叱责罚跪打板子，重的话就直接没命了。
李叶青是一个穿越者，穿越到了这历史书上描述的“吃人的”封建社会。
好消息，吃上皇粮了；
坏消息，清心寡欲换的。
他像是一个机器人一样穿好衣服，低眉顺眼地看着地板，就像前世电视剧里那些恭顺的小太监一样。
至少暂时没有性命之危，只要谨慎一些，总不至于饿死。
吴总管挑着兰花指，扫视一圈周围的小太监，大多是十三四岁的少年，脸上还带着稚气，他那双阴冷的眼底竟然浮现出些许的怜惜，然后一闪而逝“今儿个是掌仪司的孙公公给你们这群小家伙教授礼仪的日子，你们这群东西都给我放亮了眼睛，竖起耳朵好好学了。
不然要是日后在宫里冲撞了哪一位贵人，丢了小命变作鬼，可不要怪我没有提醒你们。”
一众小太监已经在这几天的折磨中习惯性的学会服从。
随即分作两排跟在吴总管身后朝外走，双腿摆动的时候还会带动尚未完全愈合的伤口，让他时不时皱眉头。
即便如此，他也依旧抿着嘴一言不发，这个时候要是发出什么声音，真的会被那些教礼仪的太监拉出来做典型的。
孙公公是宫里的老人，白发白眉，一身干净的衣服，没有太监身上常见的腥臊味道。
按照吴总管的说法，他入宫的时候孙公公就已经是这副样子了，这么多年一点都没变。
李叶青看着端坐在上方的孙公公，突然间好像意识到什么。
“不对啊，三十年样貌不变？这人成了老妖怪不成？又或者这个世界存在超凡的力量？可以修炼？”
一想到这里，李叶青心中忍不住激动，连带着脸上都带着两分红晕。
因为他知道，自己的幸福，大概还有机会！
我的人生不再黑暗了！
孙公公看着眼前这新到的一批小太监，眼神像是鹰隼一样扫过，落在李叶青的身上。
“好小子，本督公的眼皮子底下还敢走神？来人，把这家伙给我吊到门外，让他好好清醒清醒脑子，知道这里是什么地方？”
看到两个年长一些的太监向着自己走来，脸上带着阴翳的笑容。
李叶青一瞬间觉得。
他的天，塌了
夜晚，李叶青侧躺在床上，脊背上传来火辣辣的疼痛，白天被吊起来的时候那两个家伙故意勒的紧一些，甚至后背上都留下了血痕。
他也不能趴着，因为前面也有伤，更疼。
这时隔壁铺的周刘培凑了过来。
“青哥，你没事吧？”
“没，嘶，事，没两天就好了。”
这时候周刘培这家伙贼兮兮地凑了过来，伸手从怀里拿出来一样东西。
药膏！
“总管赏的，让我给你用上，还让我叮嘱你明天不要再走神了，皇城里，咱们这些命贱的家伙，一个不小心就得去见阎王。”
李叶青点了点头，心中对于吴总管带上一些感激，赶忙让周刘培撩起自己后背的衣衫，一点点地涂抹着药膏。
“嘶，你轻点。”
content_en:
"Get out of here quickly. If you dare to mess up the nobles' affairs, watch your skin carefully!"
The sharp and harsh voice of a drake reached his ears. The young man lying on the cold wooden bed opened his eyes, and then quickly started to put on his clothes.
After a few days of adapting, he has clearly understood the consequences of slow movements. It can range from scolding him to kneel down and hitting the board, to death in severe cases.
Li Yeqing is a time traveler who has traveled through the "man-eating" feudal society described in history books.
Good news, you can eat royal food;
Bad news, for those who are willing to change their minds.
He dressed like a robot, looking at the floor with his eyebrows lowered, just like those submissive little eunuchs in TV series in his previous life.
At least his life is not in danger for the time being. As long as he is careful, he will not starve to death.
Manager Wu picked up his orchid finger and scanned the surrounding young eunuchs. Most of them were teenagers of thirteen or fourteen years old, with childish looks on their faces. A little pity appeared in his cold eyes, and then it flashed away. "Today is the day when Eunuch Sun of the Master of Ceremonies teaches etiquette to you little guys. You guys have opened your eyes and pricked up your ears to learn from them."
Otherwise, if you bump into a nobleman in the palace in the future and lose your life and become a ghost, don't blame me for not warning you. "
"Yes."
All the little eunuchs have learned to obey habitually through the torture in the past few days.
Then he divided into two rows and followed Manager Wu outside. When his legs swung, they would also stir up wounds that had not yet fully healed, causing him to frown from time to time.
Even so, he still pursed his lips and said nothing. If he made any noise at this time, he would really be pulled out by the eunuchs who taught etiquette to be a typical example.
Eunuch Sun is an old man in the palace. He has white hair and white eyebrows. He is dressed in clean clothes and does not have the fishy smell that is common in eunuchs.
According to Manager Wu, Eunuch Sun was already like this when he entered the palace, and it hasn't changed at all over the years.
Li Yeqing looked at Eunuch Sun who was sitting above him, and suddenly seemed to realize something.
"That's not right. His appearance has not changed in thirty years? Has this person become an old monster? Or maybe there is extraordinary power in this world? Can he practice?"
When he thought of this, Li Yeqing couldn't help but feel excited, even with a blush on his face.
Because he knows that there is probably still a chance for his own happiness!
My life is no longer dark!
Eunuch Sun looked at the newly arrived group of young eunuchs in front of him, his eyes sweeping over Li Yeqing like a hawk.
"Good boy, how dare you lose your focus right under the eyes of this governor? Come here, hang this guy outside the door so that he can clear his mind and know where this place is?"
"?"
He saw two older eunuchs walking towards him, with sinister smiles on their faces.
Li Yeqing felt it for a moment.
His sky has fallen
At night, Li Yeqing lay on his side on the bed, feeling a burning pain on his back. When he was hung up during the day, the two guys deliberately tightened his grip, and there were even blood marks on his back.
He couldn't lie down either, because there was also an injury on the front and it hurt even more.
At this time, Zhou Liupei from the next door shop came over.
"Brother Qing, are you okay?"
"No, it's okay. It'll be fine in two days."
At this time, Zhou Liupei came over mischievously, stretched out his hand and took out something from his arms.
ointment!
"General Manager, let me put it to use for you. I also told you not to be distracted tomorrow. In the imperial city, we guys with low lives will have to meet the King of Hell if we are not careful."
Li Yeqing nodded, feeling grateful to Manager Wu, and quickly asked Zhou Liupei to lift up the clothes on his back and apply the ointment bit by bit.
"Hey, please be gentle."
